verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, a hardware processor that holds no user account data. Exporting all of one's data in open formats and leaving is a data-portability question for services and software, not for silicon. Nothing in the evidence shows the chip ships any data-export capability, so this is a category error rather than a missing feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
